newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Camelot to raise A$34.9 mln in rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Camelot to raise A$34.9 mln in rights issue.

text.p: Gold producer Camelot Resources NL said on Tuesday it would raise A$34.9 million in a three-for-five renounceable rights issue at 28 cents per share .
Camelot said the funds would be used to refinance its share of the acquisition of Mt Edon Gold Mines (Aust) Ltd, made jointly with Canada's Teck Corporation earlier this year.

"In order for Camelot to repay its share of the bridging facility and earn its share of the Mt Edon assets, Camelot must contribute a further A$32.5 million to go to 30 percent ownership or A$59.1 million to earn a 50 percent stake under its agreement with Teck Corporation," Camelot said.
The company said it intended to go to 50 percent ownership, and that the rights issue together with a A$25 million convertible note issue announced last week would provide sufficient funding.
Teck Corporation, Camelot's largest shareholder, had agreed to take up its entitlement of the issue.
Closing date for entitlements is July 4.
